description: Email a message from the connected person to the owner of a property on Fabrica (Sepolia Testnet), through Fabrica: the message (up to 1000 characters, in the person's words) goes out from the email address on the person's Fabrica account, so the owner replies to them directly, and the owner is told which property it is about. Works for a property that is set up and for one still being added once its owner has claimed it. Checks first that the owner can be reached (they have a verified email on Fabrica) and is not the person themselves. wallet is the person's own linked wallet the message is sent from (left out: the account's main wallet). A message that looks like it carries a private key or seed phrase is refused. Nothing is drafted for later: calling this tool sends the message. Needs the messaging grant ("Send messages to other Fabrica users for you").

message.description: The message, in the person's words, up to 1000 characters. Fabrica emails it to the owner from the person's own email address, so the owner can reply directly; say who is asking and what about.

tokenId.description: The token ID of the property

wallet.description: The person's own wallet the message is sent from (0x address); it must be linked to the connected account. Leave it out, or pass "me", for the account's main wallet.

name: contact_land_owner
title: Contact a property's owner
